stories.title: Add step 1b: verify in-flight async work before any output artifact is written
stories.description: New step in spell-close-session.prompt.md, positioned before the journal/TODO/handoff writes (D1), defining the 5-state vocabulary (D2) and requiring a stated verification action for unverifiable items (D3).
acceptanceCriteria: New step exists and is ordered before step 2 (journal write)
All 5 states present: dispatched, pending, succeeded, failed, unverifiable
unverifiable requires stating the exact verification action, not just the label
stories.testEvidence: test/prompt-pending-verification.test.ts's 'close-session pending-verification vocabulary' suite: 4/4 passing, including an ordering check (step 1b's text index precedes the journal-write step's) and exact-text checks for the unverifiable requirement.

stories.title: Add Pending Verification field to the handoff template
stories.description: New field in the ## Next Session Handoff markdown template (step 5b), positioned after Blockers.
acceptanceCriteria: Field present in the template with population rules referencing step 1b's findings
"None" is the documented value when nothing is outstanding
stories.testEvidence: test/prompt-pending-verification.test.ts's 'handoff template Pending Verification field' suite: 3/3 passing, including field-ordering (between Blockers and Notes) and presence in the fresh-install ai-context template stub, not just the prompt's own markdown template.

stories.title: Update Rules section and TODO.md/journal instructions to require the vocabulary
stories.description: Rules section keeps existing 'do not invent completions' line, appends the vocabulary reference (R1/R4). TODO.md step 4 and journal step 2 instructions updated so only succeeded work is described as done.
acceptanceCriteria: Rules section references the 5-state vocabulary, not just the original ambiguous phrasing
TODO.md-update step and journal-write step both scope completion claims to succeeded only
stories.testEvidence: test/prompt-pending-verification.test.ts's 'completion claims scoped to succeeded only' suite: 4/4 passing.

stories.title: spell-open-session: re-verify pending items, don't just relay them
stories.description: Handoff Detection section updated per D5 -- actively check current status of anything not already succeeded/failed from the prior handoff's Pending Verification field.
acceptanceCriteria: Handoff Detection references checking current status for pending/dispatched/unverifiable items, not just displaying prior text
stories.testEvidence: test/prompt-pending-verification.test.ts's 'open-session re-verifies pending items' suite: 2/2 passing, also confirming the original handoff-surfacing behavior (Picking Up From Last Session, Next Session Plan) is preserved alongside the new check.

stories.title: Regression coverage + self-host parity
stories.description: String-assertion tests for all of the above; regenerate and verify parity for both edited prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: New/extended test file asserts the vocabulary, step ordering, handoff field, and open-session re-verification wording
stories.testEvidence: New test/prompt-pending-verification.test.ts: 13/13 passing.
